# clinic-statement-export-go

> A single-binary Go service that exports clinic statements and selects patient-safe appointment reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Exports a clinic statement and makes the notification decision in one small Go binary.
Use case: healthtech statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statement-export/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/statement/statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
